what_happened: Task 918's VERIFIED STARTING POSITION describes the record as of the 15th wired probe (ladder-residue-index-refutation.lean, Oct 13). The record has advanced to the 47th+ probe: CounterQuotient.lean now carries kappa/ParamsOk/(K1)-(K4) with paramsOk_params DISCHARGING all four, and LadderCell.lean carries five restricted depth-0 cell-equality schemas. The dispatch's second admissible outcome (a refutation that the two constraints cannot be jointly met) is already foreclosed by the compiled paramsOk_params. Research had to re-derive the current frontier from source before it could scope the task.

The open frontier reduces to a single named obligation: kappa_collision_monotone_or_antitone_named makes the monotone and antitone slices exhaustive over every kappa-collision, and both slices are already dispatched as depth-0 cell EQUALITY under ForwardSlackWitnessed hypotheses. So the only gap between the landed schemas and the reserved cellLE_zero_const_of_kappa_eq is discharging ForwardSlackWitnessed at a positive amount.

Independently derived the forward deletion cascade (delete a type-respecting block inside the first region above z's, iterate) and its doubling arithmetic as the natural route to the discharge, then found it already landed as exists_deleted_ladderPath_of_next_region_nxt and already REFUTED by the wired probe specs/evidence/forward-slack-pin-cascade/pin-cascade-straddle.lean (hanch fails by l, hstraddle by 2*l; cascadeBound attains its own recurrence with equality). Reading the owning module docstrings before planning saved an implement dispatch against a closed route.

Layer A of the plan's decision gate was compiled at plan-authoring time rather than deferred: all four pinned arithmetic statements (kappa_collision_window_room plus the three pin-compatibility lemmas) elaborate sorry-free through lake env lean, preserved as specs/918_.../evidence/plan-gate-arithmetic.lean. This removes the pinned-signature hazard that forced a mid-task revision on task 917, because every Challenge-pinned identifier in this plan is already measured rather than asserted.

Phase 1 landed with zero proof rework: all four window-regime arithmetic theorems were lifted VERBATIM from the plan-time compiled measurement evidence/plan-gate-arithmetic.lean and compiled first try, zero errors and zero warnings, with the copyright/cycles/mk_all/typst gates green on the first run. Pinning only already-compiled statements in the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block is what made this possible.

Phase 2's decision gate PASSED, and the compiled attempt corrected a plan prediction: the hypothesis jP <= E (the idle compensator is at least as long as the raise) was written into the anchor-clause lemma and the elaborator reported it UNREFERENCED. The idle insertion displaces z's region start and the anchor by the same amount, so the anchor clause never reads the compensator's length; the compensator is spent entirely in the pin PAIR clause against pins strictly below the lengthened run. Writing the hypothesis and letting the elaborator reject it is what surfaced this -- an argument would have carried the wrong attribution into Phase 3.

The module-inventory regeneration (scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory, Phase 7's Condition-1 surface (a)) rewrote FOUR tracked files: README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md (both in Phase 7's file list), plus FormalSystem/README.md and FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/README.md, which are absent from it -- and the plan's risk table declares RaySummary/README.md READ-ONLY for this task because a sibling task holds it in its file_scope. The plan's own Phase 7 Scope Hypothesis resolves the tension ('add any file they touch that is absent here'), and leaving the INV gate red from this task's own new module would have been worse, so the regeneration was run and the row's hand-written description supplied. The edit is confined to one generated row plus one hand-written description cell, so a sibling's concurrent regeneration merges rather than conflicts. Recorded because the risk table and the Scope Hypothesis disagree about the same file.

Phase 3 closed [PARTIAL] rather than [COMPLETED]. The plan budgeted 2.5h for 'both directions' of the composite splice at an estimated +220 lines; the raising primitive's ADMISSIBILITY HALF ALONE came to +276 lines, and the plan's task list did not surface that the raise has to be ITERATED to reach an exact multiple of P + 1 while the only landed iterate (exists_iterSpliced_ladderPath_idx_of_pend_past) carries the pending-forever hypothesis this regime denies -- in two separate places. The composite's own formulation also had to be redesigned mid-phase to be iterable at all (stating every clause about the idle-lengthened path alone, with a decreasing budget invariant, rather than relative to the original path). That redesign is recorded in full in the plan's Phase 3 notes and the phase-3 handoff so it is not re-derived, but the underestimate is the reason three of seven phases landed rather than seven.

Reading the landed code rather than the record found LadderAgree.lean's exists_ladderPath_at_region_of_idle_past -- 'THE INTERFACE, IN THE IDLE-PAST REGIME' -- a landed state-level raise in this very regime with its own pin clause (insPins_of_region_start) already discharged by a different compensator (idle INSERTION rather than idle-block duplication). It does not subsume the plan's primitive (no register, no type, one cycle length, and it carries hself), so the plan's route was followed; but its docstring independently records that the UNCOMPENSATED splice is REFUTED in this regime, which corroborates Phase 2's PASS verdict from an outside construction and establishes that the compensator is a necessary payment rather than a design convenience. The plan's own research integration had asserted that the window regime 'is addressed by no landed inclusion in either direction' -- true of cell inclusions, but a near-miss at the path level that only the code showed.

omega failed with an internal 'Application type mismatch' in its own generated proof term (Lean.Omega.Int.sub_congr) on the class-2 anchor goal inside the window-regime iterate's succ branch -- not a false goal, an omega elaboration failure in a large context containing Exists.choose-headed terms. Worked around by factoring the four arithmetic steps into named lemmas over plain naturals (window_iter_anchor_raise, window_iter_anchor_shift, window_iter_slack_raise, window_iter_budget_raise), which is also the module's established style.

The iterable reformulation of the composite pin trichotomy is strictly SHORTER than the relative one landed in dispatch 3.1: the pending stretch (a, u+l] forces a region start at or above a to BE a, so the class-1 clause needs no agreement hypothesis and the idle-run condition drops out of the trichotomy entirely. The idle run re-enters only as a numeric budget R. Both new clauses compiled on the first attempt.

Phase 3's LOWERING primitive is NOT the raising direction's mirror and is excluded on a compiled measurement. The anchor clause at the region start reverses direction when the in-region block is deleted: it needs nxtAt g z + jP <= cntAt g z + 2*d + 1, a bound on the register from ABOVE, whereas kappa_collision_window_room's lowering branch supplies only c <= n and the path's own nxtAt_le_cntAt_region_start bound is TIGHT at n = c + 2d + 1. The pin pair clause is short by the same jP: window_pin_compat_lower_of_spacing's hsp is regionStart_spacing PLUS the displacement, and regionStart_spacing gives only W + 1 <= DW. Under Phase 2's own gate criterion a sixth hypothesis is a FAIL, not a widening, so the condition was NOT added. Measured by specs/918_ladder_cell_index_positive_factorization/evidence/lowering-anchor-deficit.lean and landed as window_lower_anchor_not_implied / window_lower_anchor_fails_at_tight_bound / window_lower_anchor_of_required.
